name: me.sungbin.kakaotalkbotbasemodule.library.service.BackgroundService
description: Jisungbin's KakaoTalkBotBaseModule starts this foreground service when the app enables background bot support. It keeps the device awake and shows a persistent notification with a bot on/off shortcut.
disableEffect: The service will no longer keep the device awake for background bot work, and its persistent notification and shortcut will be gone.
